reason_consistency.summary: 423 citations from 300 ledger entries (20 skipped as code-generated gate reasons): 93.2% consistent, 4.8% contradicted, 1.9% weak, 112 unscored (considered verdict). 3.2% of checkable reasons cited nothing in the phrase map (vague).
